async function craftEightJunglePlanks(bot) {
    // The function aims to ensure the bot has at least eight jungle planks. It first checks the current plank count and calculates how many more are needed. If planks are missing, it determines the required number of jungle logs. If logs are insufficient, it searches for and mines nearby jungle logs. Finally, it crafts the necessary number of jungle planks using the found logs and existing planks.
}
